name: Waiting Skeleton
look: A plastic skeleton sits slumped on a weathered wooden bench in a grassy yard, one bony arm draped on the armrest and its skull tilted back, as if it has been waiting there for ages. Straw bales sit behind it.
use: The caption names something that is taking forever, like a reply, a delivery or an update, and the skeleton shows the person waited so long they died on the bench.
examples: who said he was five minutes away
Me waiting for the game to go on sale
describe: skeleton sitting on a bench waiting forever
bones of a person on a park bench like they died waiting
skeleton slumped on a wooden bench in the grass
waited so long they turned into a skeleton
halloween skeleton chilling on an outdoor bench
